title: Reflection-compatible learned stage and motion encoding
coverage_gap: Revision feedback selects A3 at score0.875: C=20/20 and E=15/20. All five of A3's E failures are HL (0/5), while A2 has E-HL4/5 but E-LH0/5. The declared E-HL reset intervals imply a negative peg-to-box y offset of0.225-0.275m, much larger than support's roughly0.041-0.059m. Positive E-LH offsets are0.125-0.175m and were handled by A3 (5/5). These aggregate results motivate combining the complementary representation biases; they do not reveal the actual failed motions or causally isolate reflection, routing, or auxiliary losses.
reusable_regularity: A lateral coordinate reflection and a geometric stage representation should compose: contact, vertical progress and transverse error norm are reflection invariant, while lateral displacement and velocity reverse sign. Retain A2's learned reach/insert encoders, invariant soft router and short-horizon motion supervision, but express all local vectors, actions and auxiliary motion labels in A3's causal contact-conditioned lateral frame. Retain world asymmetry explicitly. Use action4 diffusion rather than A3's joint ten-channel diffusion to avoid requiring a long, poorly covered transport trajectory to be modeled as a future-error sequence.
dependencies_preserved: PegGrasp-hand, goal-pegHead, and pegHead-pegGrasp remain distinct vector channels. Reach and insertion branches use the corresponding geometry rather than substituting one object point for the other.

All signed local vectors, native previous-step velocities, and current/previous quaternions use a single chunk-start reflection consistently for both history observations. The quaternion axial-vector mapping is (s*qx,qy,s*qz,qw).

Stage-router inputs are norms, aperture/difference, world heights, x insertion error and vertical peg motion. They are invariant to lateral reflection and have no elapsed-step, future-truth, or phase-oracle input.

Absolute hand and goal xyz are retained, unreflected, in both the coarse world encoder and direct path. Explicit parity lets the policy relate canonical local geometry to the asymmetric robot/world. Table height and signed insertion x are never removed or rotated.
A0.15 gate floor and ungated geometric path preserve corrective information when stage inference is wrong. Native current/previous gripper state remains scalar and unreflected.
No simulator obstacle query or hidden box pose is used. Only the supplied goal represents box placement, and only the declared absent object2 channels are discarded.

evidence_refs.use: Exact D5 training scope remains unchanged in revision.
Factor intervals establish the extreme negative E-HL transport magnitude; raw channels and native action semantics are unchanged.
Narrow one-sided transport support offsets and both signs of initial reach offset; five episodes and415 transitions.
Free approach geometry differs from contact and transport.
Contact/transport configuration motivates geometric rather than elapsed-time stage inputs.
Raised, side-opening insertion retains gravity and x-axis dependencies.
Evidence for small-aperture near-contact surrogate, later coherent transport and alignment, and different roles of grasp/head points.
Hand/head displacement is a physically interpretable short-horizon auxiliary label during HH transport.

A1 score0.525; A2 score0.65 with C-HL5/10,C-LH7/10,E-HL4/5,E-LH0/5; A3 score0.875 with both C cells10/10,E-HL0/5,E-LH5/5. Both A2 and A3 E-LL/E-HH are5/5. q3 selected A3 uniquely. No dev trajectory states or hidden tests were supplied or accessed.
Retain branch sizes, invariant router inputs, gate floor, short-horizon head, physical scales and auxiliary weights.
Retain causal contact-conditioned y reflection,5mm deadband, explicit parity and quaternion/vector frame semantics; do not retain joint diffusion targets.
One new A4 slot, one common U-Net and frozen control/training semantics.
Mask normalization, causal training/inference isolation and final fixed-update EMA evaluation.

expected_failure_signature: The specific revision hypothesis predicts better E-HL coverage than A3's0/5 while retaining its positive-offset coverage. If A2's E-HL advantage was seed-specific rather than a useful representation bias, A4 can retain the same long-negative-offset truncations.
If A3's joint future channels rather than its reflection were essential to positive-direction transfer, removing them may lose E-LH or C success even with the correct mirrored action semantics.
A closed empty or slipping grasp can still trigger the frame rule and corrupt stage routing; parity can still switch near the5mm boundary and cause y oscillation.

A learned world encoder can overfit the original peg-y/box-y correlation despite canonical local inputs. This would appear as cell-dependent failures rather than uniformly improved extrapolation. The small per-cell development sample sizes do not establish any of these mechanisms.

action_frame_semantics.frame: Exactly the A3 rule, computed once conceptually from causal raw_current at each chunk start: s=-1 if aperture<0.5, norm(pegGrasp-hand)<0.065m, and goal_y-pegHead_y>0.005m; otherwise s=+1. It is deterministic and recomputed from the identical context whenever required, without persistent state.
action_frame_semantics.encode_decode: Encode all16 rows as [dx,s*dy,dz,gripper] and decode with the same involution. No future state or prediction selects a frame. Native x/z,0.01m/unit displacement scale, fixed wrist orientation and gripper[g,-g] are unchanged. Only the host clips the native action cube and executes four of sixteen actions.
action_frame_semantics.conditioning_and_motion: The same s reflects signed local vector y components and applies S R S to orientation channels. Auxiliary hand/head displacements are also reflected by the same chunk-start s; world contextual hand/goal positions are deliberately unreflected with parity retained.

training_only_targets.name: phase_distribution
training_only_targets.source: Exact D5 obs[t], using the unchanged A2 contact surrogate(aperture<0.5 and hand/grasp distance<0.065m) and alignment surrogate(abs goal-head y,z<0.035m). Three phases: approach/close, contact transport, contact aligned insertion; label smoothing0.05. These are surrogate annotations, not reward or simulator contact truth.
training_only_targets.loss: Cross entropy from predicted causal probabilities, normalized by sum(mask[:,0]) and weighted0.05. Targets are never inference conditioning.

training_only_targets.name: future_delta4_world
training_only_targets.source: Exact D5 differences obs[t+4]-obs[t] for hand_xyz and pegHead_xyz, divided by0.04m. Endpoint padding is finite and excluded when action offset3 is invalid. In training_loss reflect these six components by the causal chunk-start s, not by a future frame.
training_only_targets.loss: The117-64-6 motion head predicts the canonical displacement from current learned conditioning. SmoothL1 weight0.1, denominator6*sum(mask[:,3]), safe empty-set normalization. This head is not called at inference and never transforms actions.

architecture: One common factory DP with condition_dim117 and diffusion_action_dim4. Retain A2 reach20-64-32, insertion20-64-32, world6-32-16 and stage10-32-3 SiLU MLPs; joint-training-only motion head117-64-6. Condition is gated32+32,world16,phase3,ungated geometry33,parity1. No extra backbone, parent-weight reuse, ensemble, planner, joint diffusion channels, or pretraining.
loss_and_budget: Common action epsilon loss is untouched: encoded native4 first, weight1 and denominator mask.sum()*4. Two separately mask-normalized nonnegative auxiliary losses as documented above. Same optimizer, updates, horizons, seeds, splits and final-checkpoint rule as all candidates.
support_fit_statistics: None beyond the frozen host normalizer. Phase and motion labels are computed from current D5 only via training_targets and never cached in deployment state. No development states are used for fitting.
change_summary: One feedback-driven new scientific slot: combine A2's learned causal stage/motion representation with A3's contact-conditioned action reflection. Relative to A2, consistently reflect local features, quaternions, action y and motion labels and add parity. Relative to A3, replace its fixed feature map and joint10-channel outcome diffusion by A2-style learned conditioning and action4 diffusion with masked short-horizon auxiliary heads. All thresholds, gate settings and auxiliary-head weights are retained from their parent rather than searched. A1-A3 remain immutable; q3 was recorded before implementation. No A4 performance has been observed.
